title: Wondrous King all Glorious
lyrics_original: Wondrous King, all glorious, Sovereign Lord victorious,
O, receive our praise with favor!
From Thee welled God's kindness tho' we in our blindness
Strayed from Thee, our blessed Savior.
Strengthen thou, help us now;
Let our tongues be singing, Thee our praises bringing.
Heavens, spread the story of our Maker's glory,
All the pomp of earth obscuring.
Sun, thy rays be sending, thy bright beams expending,
Light to all the earth assuring.
Moon and star, praise afar
Him who glorious made you; The vast heavens aid you.
O my soul, rejoicing, sing, thy praises voicing,
Sing, with hymns of faith adore Him!
All who here have being, shout, your voices freeing,
Bow down in the dust before Him.
He is God, Sabaoth;
Praise alone the Savior, here and there for ever.
Hallelujahs render to the Lord most tender,
Ye who know and love the Savior.
Hallelujahs sing ye, Ye redeemed, O, bring ye
Hearts that yield Him glad behavior.
Blest are ye, endlessly;
Sinless there forever, ye shall laud Him ever.

bible_verses.english: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

devotional.prayer_english: Wondrous King and victorious Lord, I offer You my heartfelt praise today. Thank You for looking upon me with favor and extending Your kindness when I was lost in darkness. Strengthen my heart and loosen my tongue so that I may freely sing of Your greatness. Let my life, along with all of creation, reflect the beauty of Your glory to the world around me. In Jesus' name, Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we gaze at the vastness of creation, we see the overwhelming glory of our sovereign King. Yet the most magnificent wonder is that despite our spiritual blindness, God reached out to us in tender kindness and redeemed us through Christ. As the heavens continuously declare His praise, we too are invited to lift our voices in grateful adoration. May our hearts be strengthened today as we join all creation in honoring our gracious Savior.
